newsitem.title: USA: MOODY'S UPS NAC RE CORP'S SENIOR UNSECURED DEBT.
newsitem.headline: MOODY'S UPS NAC RE CORP'S SENIOR UNSECURED DEBT.

text.p: NEW YORK, July 29 - Moody's Investors Service raised its ratings of NAC Re Corporation's senior unsecured debt to Baa1, from Baa2, and of the company's senior subordinated debt, to Baa2, from Baa3. According to Moody's, these rating actions reflect consistent improvements in NAC Re's core franchise as a leading provider of property/casualty reinsurance sold through brokers. The rating outlook is stable.

Moody's further noted that in recent years, NAC Re Corporation has produced good returns in a difficult competitive environment, while maintaining conservatism in its reserving practices and good customer relationships.
NAC Re has also successfully expanded the scope of its business into international markets, and through two direct insurance subsidiaries.
At the same time the company has diversified its sources of business, NAC Re has succeeded in better diversifying its traditional reinsurance customer base.

Although financial leverage is high relative to peers, the resulting pressure on NAC Re's financial flexibility is mitigated by the debt's generally favorable terms and by firm's moderate operating leverage.
NAC Re Corporation, located in Greenwich, Connecticut, USA, operates primarily as a property and casualty reinsurer, through NAC Reinsurance Corporation, its principal operating subsidiary.
For the six months ended June 30, 1997, NAC Re reported net income of $48 million and equity of $594 million. Tuesday, 29 July 1997 20:06:07 ENDS nN2920056
